# LUMINARA · THE PORTAL

A trinary divination instrument and its library of living charts. Six rooms,
one door, no write lane.

## Why

Most symbol systems are inherited: their meanings must be taught, and they
drift with every teaching. Luminara's are derived: twenty-seven cards from
one small arithmetic, three states across three layers, and from that one
fact everything else follows, each card's opposite, its becoming, its knot,
its interval. Whoever can count in threes can rebuild the whole deck and
check every claim it makes, so nothing here rests on authority, including
the instrument itself. It is built as a still surface for a stretched age:
a mirror whose meanings hold still while you move. It shows; it never
decides.

- **THE WAYFINDER** (`/app/luminara-read.html`) — the reading instrument.
  27 cards, three states by three layers, cast by committed chance
  (unsteerable · committed · witnessable), never composed.
- **THE RING** (`/app/luminara-ring.html`) — the deck, walked: all
  twenty-seven explored by touch or arrow keys, the counter and the
  becoming as roads, each card's knot, interval, and essence in one
  place. Composed, never cast.
- **RESONANCE** (`/app/luminara-resonance.html`) — the cymatics bench: the
  cards' spectra drawn and sounded.
- **THE MAP ROOM** (`/app/luminara-map-room.html`) — the library of living
  charts: books, seeings, laws, instruments, and the wider field, curated on
  three benches (Trefoil holds what survived, Genus opens doorways, Phi turns
  work toward its invariants).
- **THE ASTROLABE** (`/app/luminara-astrolabe.html`) — time walking the
  twenty-seven: the year ring, the three clocks, the dragon's crossings.
- **THE SPECTRUM** (`/app/luminara-spectrum.html`) — the harmonic lattice.

## Run

```
bun spatial/serve.ts 7097   # http://127.0.0.1:7097 (any port; default 7096)
bun test core/tests/        # the pins
```

The server is the constitution in miniature: GET and HEAD only, two static
directories, a path-traversal guard, and nothing else. Every cast, journal,
and draft lives in the visiting browser. The room proposes files as downloads;
it never writes one.

## Provenance

This repository is the living home of the Luminara portal. It was born on
20 July 2026 from the `zeb/luminara-portal` branch of `aumara-xyz/aukora-symbiote`,
where the work's full history stands and remains the seal of record for every
dated commitment the charts cite (the letter lock, the blind window, the
pressings). The genesis commit names the exact source SHA. Nothing was cut:
the history stands whole where it always was, and this repo begins where it
left off.

The organ that lives inside the wider organism's shell (`luminara.js`, which
awards AURA under the REQ-L1 contract) deliberately did not move: it belongs
to the organism. This repository is the portal only, and it is complete.

Set down by North Star.
